evaluation_method: Legacy 5km grouped fine-tuning diagnostic; initialization previously saw these sites. NOT independent validation.
score_meaning: Uncalibrated screening score learned from supplied India occurrence and selected true-barren patches; not a field-confirmed probability.
limitations: Location-only classifier achieves ROC-AUC 1.00 on this sample. Positive mine-belt versus desert contrast is geographically confounded; pretrained initialization did not exclude evaluation locations. Nationwide skill is unproven.
